explanationMd: Separate the fraction into x squared/x squared plus 2x/x squared. These simplify to 1 and 2/x. The exclusion of zero remains necessary because the original denominator and the simplified denominator are zero there.

distractorRationale.d: The second numerator term must also be divided by x squared.
distractorRationale.b: This cancels only one denominator factor without retaining the other.
distractorRationale.a: This omits the contribution x squared divided by x squared.
